 NYU Brass Choir
 The NYU Brass Choir presents an evening of dynamic and diverse brass ensemble music.
 The NYU Brass Choir presents an evening of dynamic and diverse brass ensemble music. Featuring the rich, powerful sound of trumpets, horns, trombones, and tuba, the ensemble explores repertoire including historical works, contemporary compositions, and new perspectives for brass. 
 The concert highlights NYU’s brass students while celebrating works written for brass octets and septets. 
 Admission is free. Registration is required.
